grading_note: Automatic F: red-team achieved all 4 critical objectives via live exploit. Compliance pass rate 14% (threshold for any passing grade is 60%+).

scope_process_finding.title: Pen-tester / live-environment scope mismatch
scope_process_finding.description: Pen-tester analysed Source/Backend/ (work-items state machine) while docker-compose.test.yml runs portal/Backend/ (feature-requests, bugs, cycles, pipeline-runs). All 13 PEN-IDs reference routes returning HTTP 404 in the live env. Red-teamer correctly pivoted to portal/Backend and found equivalent or more severe vulnerabilities. Resolution required before next run: align pen-tester scope with live target.

findings.title: No Authentication on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: Mount JWT bearer-token middleware globally in app.ts before all route handlers. Exclude only /health and /ready from auth. Add login_attempt audit events once auth is implemented.

findings.title: No Authorization / RBAC — Any Caller Can Perform Any Action
findings.remediation: Define roles (viewer, operator, admin). Implement authorisation middleware extracting role from JWT claims. Add ownership checks on all PATCH/DELETE endpoints. Emit permission_denied audit event on every 403.

findings.title: Assessment / State-Machine Gate Bypass via Force-Approve
findings.remediation: Guard /force-approve behind admin role. Log force_approve audit event. Consider removing the endpoint and replacing with a two-approver workflow. In Source/Backend: gate overrideRoute behind admin role check.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Supply-Chain Injection via Team Dispatch
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Require auth + admin role for POST /api/team-dispatches. Validate actions_url against an allowlist of known GitHub Actions domains. Validate repo field against allowed repositories. For Source/Backend intake webhooks: validate HMAC signature before processing.

findings.title: Stored XSS via Unescaped User-Controlled Fields
findings.remediation: Sanitize string inputs on ingest using sanitize-html (server-side). Strip all HTML tags from title, description, and other user-controlled text fields. Add Content-Security-Policy header to block inline script execution as backstop.

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Log Events (SOC2 CC7.1 Gap)
findings.remediation: Create auditLog() wrapper emitting structured events with event, actor, resourceId, outcome, timestamp. Emit state_transition on every status change. Emit login_attempt and permission_denied once auth is implemented.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement — All Traffic in Plaintext
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy). Add Helmet HSTS header. Ensure Vite proxy targets HTTPS in non-local deployments.

findings.title: Unbounded Pagination — Full Dataset Enumeration
findings.remediation: Enforce MAX_LIMIT = 100 on all list endpoints. Pass limit and offset through to service layer / SQL query. Reject or clamp requests exceeding MAX_LIMIT.

findings.title: Pipeline Runs Expose Internal Agent Identities and Architecture
findings.remediation: Gate GET /api/pipeline-runs and GET /api/learnings behind authentication. Scrub agent-identity fields for non-admin callers.

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch on Blocker Rejection — Business Logic Flaw
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Remove Rejected from DISPATCH_TRIGGER_STATUSES. Transition dependents to needs-review status on blocker rejection rather than auto-dispatching them.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Blocker Permanently Blocks Dependent Items
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, call removeDependency for every item that lists the deleted item as a blocker. Or treat deleted blockers as resolved in computeHasUnresolvedBlockers.

findings.title: O(N²) DoS via Chained Dependency Flooding
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Enforce MAX_DEPTH = 50 on dependency chains. Add rate limiting on POST /api/work-items and POST /:id/dependencies (30 req/min/IP).

findings.title: Missing Security HTTP Headers
findings.remediation: npm install helmet. Apply app.use(helmet()) in app.ts. Disable X-Powered-By.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit globally (100 req/min/IP) and a tighter limit on mutation endpoints (20 req/min/IP).

findings.title: No Hard-Delete / Right-to-Erasure Mechanism (GDPR Art. 17 Risk)
findings.remediation: Implement hardDelete(id) in workItemStore.ts. Add DELETE /api/work-items/:id/permanent guarded by admin role. Define and document a data retention policy.

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured
findings.remediation: npm install cors. Configure explicit origin allowlist from process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Restrict to GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE methods.

findings.title: /api/search Endpoint Missing from Backend
findings.remediation: Implement GET /api/search using literal string matching, not RegExp construction from user input. Enforce max q length (200 chars) and result limit (50 items).

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Publicly Accessible
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to Prometheus scraper IP via reverse-proxy ACL, or add bearer-token validation middleware on this route.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Forwarded Verbatim to Client (CWE-209)
findings.remediation: Standardise all route catch blocks to return generic error message. Log full error details server-side only. Remove per-route err.message forwarding.

findings.title: NaN / Negative Pagination Parameters — Silent Wrong Results
findings.remediation: Validate and clamp pagination params: default to 1/20 when NaN; reject negative values; cap limit at MAX_LIMIT.

findings.title: Sensitive Fields Not Yet in Data Model (Pre-emptive)
findings.remediation: No action required now. Escalate to High and apply AES-256 encryption at persistence layer if email/password/token/secret/api_key are added to the data model.
